title: Logs, events and diagnosing a pod that will not start

videos.script: A pod that will not start always says why. The skill is knowing where it says it. {{where}} The status column gives the first word: Pending, ErrImagePull, CrashLoopBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError, or Running but not ready. Each word points at a different place to look. {{status}} Some answers are in the events, written by the scheduler and the kubelet. Some are in the container's own logs. And some are in the pod's status, waiting to be read. {{places}} You will break five pods in five different ways at once, and read each one's reason from the right place. {{plan}}
